recommendations.title: The Black Company
recommendations.author: Glen Cook
recommendations.reason: The soldier's-eye ancestor of grimdark: a weary mercenary company with no illusions, the war-is-hell tone of The Heroes and Baptism of Fire.

recommendations.title: Prince of Thorns
recommendations.author: Mark Lawrence
recommendations.reason: A brutal, charismatic young warlord with a Best Served Cold-style grudge, in a lean, fast book.

recommendations.title: The Lies of Locke Lamora
recommendations.author: Scott Lynch
recommendations.reason: Sharp banter, a vivid city and a mean streak: Abercrombie's cynicism with the heist energy of Kings of the Wyld.

recommendations.title: The Blacktongue Thief
recommendations.author: Christopher Buehlman
recommendations.reason: A debt-ridden thief joins a band of killers with a darkly funny voice: Kings of the Wyld meets Kvothe's storytelling.

recommendations.title: Senlin Ascends
recommendations.author: Josiah Bancroft
recommendations.reason: An absurd, brilliant vertical world: Cinder Spires-style invention with Strange & Norrell's dry wit.

recommendations.title: The Poppy War
recommendations.author: R.F. Kuang
recommendations.reason: A war-college story that becomes an unflinching look at atrocity; rooted in China's history like Jade War, as vengeful as The Rage of Dragons.

recommendations.title: The Traitor Baru Cormorant
recommendations.author: Seth Dickinson
recommendations.reason: Empire, economics and sacrifice: the strategic cunning of The Grace of Kings with a ruthless edge.

recommendations.title: A Game of Thrones
recommendations.author: George R.R. Martin
recommendations.reason: Political, bloody and character-driven; the genre's foundational text for fans of Gwynne and Abercrombie.

recommendations.title: The Lions of Al-Rassan
recommendations.author: Guy Gavriel Kay
recommendations.reason: A historical-flavoured tale of love and loyalty on opposite sides of a war, with the emotional pull of Robin Hobb.

recommendations.title: The Way of Shadows
recommendations.author: Brent Weeks
recommendations.reason: An orphan trained as an assassin: Assassin's Apprentice's hook at The Warded Man's pace.

recommendations.title: The Emperor's Blades
recommendations.author: Brian Staveley
recommendations.reason: Three heirs, one murdered emperor and a monastery of monks: intrigue and training in the vein of Hierarchy.

recommendations.title: The Sword of Kaigen
recommendations.author: M.L. Wang
recommendations.reason: A family of warriors facing invasion, with the martial intensity of The Burning and the clan drama of Jade Legacy.

recommendations.title: Blood Song
recommendations.author: Anthony Ryan
recommendations.reason: A gifted young warrior rises through a brutal order, close in spirit to The Rage of Dragons and Malice.

recommendations.title: Theft of Swords
recommendations.author: Michael J. Sullivan
recommendations.reason: Two thieves-for-hire and a lot of fun: a warm, quippy adventure like Kings of the Wyld.

recommendations.title: The Gunslinger
recommendations.author: Stephen King
recommendations.reason: A lone gunman in a ruined west: Lonesome Dove's frontier meets Red Country's grit, bent into dark fantasy.

recommendations.title: The Rook
recommendations.author: Daniel O'Malley
recommendations.reason: A secret magical bureaucracy hidden in modern Britain, with Rivers of London's wry voice.

recommendations.title: Neverwhere
recommendations.author: Neil Gaiman
recommendations.reason: A hidden London beneath London, by the author of American Gods.

recommendations.title: Moon Called
recommendations.author: Patricia Briggs
recommendations.reason: A mechanic who is a coyote shapeshifter among werewolves: the supernatural-underworld fun of Fool Moon.

recommendations.title: The Night Circus
recommendations.author: Erin Morgenstern
recommendations.reason: A rival-magicians love story set in a circus, with the lyrical, dreamy quality of Piranesi.

recommendations.title: The Starless Sea
recommendations.author: Erin Morgenstern
recommendations.reason: A book that leads to a buried library under the world: Piranesi's strangeness with 1Q84's layered stories.

recommendations.title: Circe
recommendations.author: Madeline Miller
recommendations.reason: The witch of the Odyssey, told lyrically; mythology as intimate fiction.

recommendations.title: The Serpent and the Wings of Night
recommendations.author: Carissa Broadbent
recommendations.reason: Deadly trials, vampire politics and a slow-burn romance, for readers who loved Fourth Wing.

recommendations.title: A Court of Thorns and Roses
recommendations.author: Sarah J. Maas
recommendations.reason: The romantasy blueprint: high stakes, fae courts and a fast, addictive plot.

recommendations.title: Good Omens
recommendations.author: Terry Pratchett & Neil Gaiman
recommendations.reason: Pratchett's wit and Gaiman's myth-mashing on the end of the world.

recommendations.title: The Princess Bride
recommendations.author: William Goldman
recommendations.reason: Swashbuckling and satire in a single book, with the same loving mockery as Discworld.

recommendations.title: Children of Time
recommendations.author: Adrian Tchaikovsky
recommendations.reason: A colony of uplifted spiders and a dying humanity: big ideas with Murderbot's humanity and Jemisin's scale.

recommendations.title: A Memory Called Empire
recommendations.author: Arkady Martine
recommendations.reason: A court-intrigue space opera about language and empire, with the politics of The Grace of Kings.

recommendations.title: Ancillary Justice
recommendations.author: Ann Leckie
recommendations.reason: An AI in a single body seeks revenge: a thoughtful companion to Murderbot.

recommendations.title: Leviathan Wakes
recommendations.author: James S. A. Corey
recommendations.reason: Noir detective meets space opera, with war and politics on a solar-system scale.

recommendations.title: Dune
recommendations.author: Frank Herbert
recommendations.reason: Politics, prophecy and ecology on a desert world: Stormlight's scope with The Will of the Many's intrigue.

recommendations.title: The Forever War
recommendations.author: Joe Haldeman
recommendations.reason: The grown-up, bitter counterpart to Ender's Game.

recommendations.title: Snow Crash
recommendations.author: Neal Stephenson
recommendations.reason: The cyberpunk original of virtual worlds, a pizza-delivering samurai hero and all.

recommendations.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
recommendations.author: Douglas Adams
recommendations.reason: Absurdist space comedy that would sit comfortably next to Discworld and Dungeon Crawler Carl.

recommendations.title: He Who Fights with Monsters
recommendations.author: Shirtaloon
recommendations.reason: A modern man reborn in a world with a leveling system: progression fantasy with humour.

recommendations.title: Unsouled
recommendations.author: Will Wight
recommendations.reason: Fast, propulsive power-progression fantasy, the first book of Cradle.

recommendations.title: Brave New World
recommendations.author: Aldous Huxley
recommendations.reason: The pleasure-numbed counterpart to 1984's brute force.

recommendations.title: Fahrenheit 451
recommendations.author: Ray Bradbury
recommendations.reason: A fireman who burns books starts to read them.

recommendations.title: Parable of the Sower
recommendations.author: Octavia E. Butler
recommendations.reason: A visionary teenager in a collapsing America; the same urgency as The Broken Earth.

recommendations.title: Slaughterhouse-Five
recommendations.author: Kurt Vonnegut
recommendations.reason: War as absurd, tragic comedy: Catch-22's brother.

recommendations.title: The Master and Margarita
recommendations.author: Mikhail Bulgakov
recommendations.reason: The Devil visits Soviet Moscow: satire, fantasy and romance in one.

recommendations.title: Blood Meridian
recommendations.author: Cormac McCarthy
recommendations.reason: The darkest western ever written, for readers of Lonesome Dove and Red Country.

recommendations.title: True Grit
recommendations.author: Charles Portis
recommendations.reason: A fourteen-year-old hires a U.S. marshal to avenge her father: a witty, clear-eyed western.

recommendations.title: The Sisters Brothers
recommendations.author: Patrick deWitt
recommendations.reason: Two hired killers on the Gold Rush trail, with black humour.

recommendations.title: The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle
recommendations.author: Haruki Murakami
recommendations.reason: Often considered Murakami's masterpiece: a missing cat, a missing wife and a well.

recommendations.title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
recommendations.author: Gabriel García Márquez
recommendations.reason: The landmark of magical realism, a century of a family in Macondo.

recommendations.title: The Snowman
recommendations.author: Jo Nesbø
recommendations.reason: Bleak Scandinavian winter, a damaged detective and a serial killer with a signature.

recommendations.title: Smilla's Sense of Snow
recommendations.author: Peter Høeg
recommendations.reason: A Greenlandic-Danish outsider investigates a boy's death in snowy Copenhagen.

recommendations.title: Killing Floor
recommendations.author: Lee Child
recommendations.reason: Jack Reacher's debut: a drifter, a small town and a conspiracy.

recommendations.title: Foundryside
recommendations.author: Robert Jackson Bennett
recommendations.reason: A thief, a magic system built on commands and a city of merchant houses: inventive, fast and Lynch-ish.

recommendations.title: Hyperion
recommendations.author: Dan Simmons
recommendations.reason: Seven pilgrims, seven stories, one terrible destination: the Canterbury Tales in space.

recommendations.title: The Priory of the Orange Tree
recommendations.author: Samantha Shannon
recommendations.reason: Dragons, queens and a world-spanning conflict, standalone and complete.

recommendations.title: Gideon the Ninth
recommendations.author: Tamsyn Muir
recommendations.reason: Necromancers in space, a locked-room mystery and irreverent humour, for fans of Dungeon Crawler Carl's tone.
